title: ActMotd
description: A professional two-line MOTD and join/quit message plugin for Paper servers with color and PlaceholderAPI support.
body:
ActMotd is a clean, production-ready MOTD + Join/Quit message plugin for Paper/Spigot servers.

Features
- Two-line MOTD system (line1 + line2)
- MOTD rotation modes: single / random / sequence
- Color support: legacy (&) + hex (&#RRGGBB on 1.16+)
- Optional PlaceholderAPI placeholders in MOTD and messages
- Custom join/quit broadcasts with vanilla join/quit suppression
- Reload command: /actmotd reload (no restart needed)
- Optional favicon support (64x64 PNG)

Commands
- /actmotd reload
Permission: actmotd.reload (default: op)

- ![MOTD](https://imagedelivery.net/W9K_l6ndK9x4x8m3rurakg/23bbc88b-82ee-448e-0c5c-ac92ed7a7900/original)

- ![MOTD](https://imagedelivery.net/W9K_l6ndK9x4x8m3rurakg/fc2a9693-fbf7-442f-e133-a3254669b900/original)

Configuration
- motd.mode: single | random | sequence
- motd.entries:
  - line1: "..."
    line2: "..."
- joinquit.join / joinquit.quit lists (fully editable)

- ![Join Messages](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c1b5e63d7f3b3a00a100d51a33050e6d00f75c00.webp)

- ![Leave Messages](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c8a8ae1e0b98426ef0f4f0628b3fa0a70d8dbd19.png)

- Optional dependency

- PlaceholderAPI (softdepend). If installed, placeholders are parsed; otherwise the plugin still works.

Support
If you face any issues, share your server version and latest.log with the error section.
